 Today's Aquarius Tarot Card Reading Prediction, October 25, 2026: The percentage of business profit will remain average. Progress will be made through coordination with authorities. Professional matters will be maintained well. Transactions will be successful.
 Advertisement Aquarius Tarot Horoscope Prediction Today, October 25, 2026 By: Arunesh Kumar Sharma New Delhi , Oct 25, 2026 07:26 IST Last Updated Oct 25, 2026 07:26 IST Published by India Today Web Desk Oct 25, 2026 07:26 IST Aquarius 
 Eight of Pentacles 
 Today emphasises promoting your professional activities and maintaining consistency in your work. Discipline will help sustain a positive position in business. The percentage of business profit will remain average. Progress will be made through coordination with those responsible. Professional matters will be kept in good shape. Transactions will be successful. Necessary tasks will be completed.
 You will ignore what people say. You will show enthusiasm in agreements. Self-control will be maintained. You will move in the right direction with wisdom. Support from peers and colleagues will continue. Avoid stubbornness and haste. Stay away from greed and temptation. Approach pending tasks with patience. There will be an emphasis on discipline. You will keep work pressure under control.
